Panel.signature: Panel(children: (Metric | DataTable | Callout | BarChart | ProductGrid | ProductCard | AddonGrid | AddonCard | MediaGrid | MediaCard)[])
Panel.description: Root vertical stack for every analytics answer.

Metric.signature: Metric(label: string, value: string, hint?: string)
Metric.description: A KPI. value is preformatted text such as "128" or "₹12,400".

DataTable.description: A compact table. columns is header labels. rows is an array of string arrays aligned to columns.

Callout.description: A note. tone info for empty results or explanations, warning for refusals or clamp notices.

BarChart.signature: BarChart(title: string, labels: string[], values: number[])
BarChart.description: Horizontal bars. labels and values are parallel arrays of the same length.

ProductGrid.description: A wrap of ProductCard items. Use for top sold products or catalog lists. Never use when the tool returned empty: true. Never use for addons.

ProductCard.signature: ProductCard(name: string, imageUrl: string, gmvLabel?: string, quantity?: number, priceLabel?: string, compareAtLabel?: string, percentOff?: number, instantLabel?: string, badgeLabel?: string)
ProductCard.description: Storefront-style product card. Copy imageUrl, priceLabel, compareAtLabel, percentOff, instantLabel, badgeLabel from the tool. gmvLabel and quantity are optional sales extras. Empty strings hide those chips.

AddonGrid.description: A wrap of AddonCard items for list-addons answers. Never use ProductCard here. Never use when empty: true.

AddonCard.signature: AddonCard(name: string, imageUrl: string, priceLabel?: string, compareAtLabel?: string, percentOff?: number, colorName?: string, colorHex?: string)
AddonCard.description: Storefront-style add-on card (image, name, price). Copy imageUrl, priceLabel, compareAtLabel, percentOff, colorName, colorHex from catalog_addons. Never use for products.

MediaGrid.description: A wrap of MediaCard items for list-media answers. Never use when empty: true.

MediaCard.signature: MediaCard(name: string, imageUrl: string, kind?: string, sizeLabel?: string, dimensions?: string)
MediaCard.description: Media-library file. Copy name, imageUrl, kind, sizeLabel, dimensions from catalog_media. Never use for products or addons.
